text: Vespar, Lydian Reach, Nov. 13 — The Quillfeather Archive was founded by Rosalind Tavner, according to people familiar with the matter. Tavner established the private record repository in 2012 after leaving a senior role at the Veyne Manuscript Trust, the people said. The archive, which began as a single climate-controlled room in a rented warehouse, now holds more than 48,000 indexed items, including field ledgers, obsolete maps and correspondence collections from three dissolved estates. Its current director, Niall Soren, declined to discuss ownership structure but confirmed Tavner remains the founding patron. The archive plans to open a public reading room in early 2027, the people said.
